what: Launcher argv omits required prompt source
scenario_or_breakage: launch-review.sh and launch-claude-review.sh require exactly one of --prompt, --agent-file, or --prompt-file (scripts/launch-review.sh:204-206, scripts/launch-claude-review.sh:65-69); the plan only passes --mode description and --description-text, so real tiers exit 2 before writing output and the waterfall never applies a patch
suggested_fix: Pass --prompt-file to the composed revise/prompt.txt (same pattern as scripts/dispatch-plan-voters.sh:71-74) plus existing --plan-file, --feature-file, --scope-files, --output, and --timeout; drop standalone --description-text unless an agent-file render path is added
